LanguageData.Gun_M1_Carbine_RWP.label: M1 Carbine
LanguageData.Gun_M1_Carbine_RWP.description: The M1 Carbine is a lightweight, semi-automatic rifle known for its ease of use and high rate of fire. Originally designed for paratroopers and support troops, it offers moderate stopping power and excellent accuracy, making it a versatile choice for mid-range engagements.
